name: VOW temporary usdRate exposure
summary: VSCTokenManager mints vUSD for any VOW sent to it at the USD rates stored on the tokens. The team raised VOW's rate to 100 USD for nine blocks to mint vUSD for itself; an attacker contract waiting since April minted vUSD at that rate 24 seconds later, swapped it for VOW and sold the VOW into the VOW/WETH and VOW/USDT pools.
notes: Cohort: the rate change came from the team's usdRateSetter 0xba1be907, but the exploiting EOA was funded through Tornado Cash and is unaffiliated; earlier temporary rate windows (blocks 17673150, 18623961, 19336624) saw only team mints.

Campaign adds the attacker's second mint 0xb569340f and its sale 0x4b439b82 of retained VOW into the same pools. Loss is the pools' WETH and USDT; VOW and vUSD are valued through those proceeds. 1M VOW bridged out via deBridge is not counted.
